harness.name: AgentArk SimpleAgent
harness.backend_role: These backends supply model access inside the same AgentArk SimpleAgent evaluation loop. The Codex SDK supplies model access for Astra.
harness.configuration_scope: Actual reasoning effort, output budgets, transport limitations and continuation conditions are reported per model.

target.title: Golden Gate Bridge
target.instruction: Reproduce the provided reference image as closely as possible.

reference.author: Frank Schulenburg
reference.modification: Full image proportionally resized to 1280 × 800; no crop.

protocol.context_management: Experience carries across rounds through SimpleAgent's managed context and archives; context compression can summarize earlier interactions. Three rounds belong to one continuing agent session.

quality.note: All models share AgentArk SimpleAgent and the task conditions. All three final canvases are retained in attempt order. The author's personal ranking is stored separately; no numerical artistic-quality scores are assigned. Submission reward checks the save/submission process. Actual reasoning settings and model-access details accompany each model.
